The edit form shows the stored values, applies the same title and due date rules as task creation, and saves the changes through the backend. The UI shows a success or error message after each save. The UI never shows a saved state when the backend call has failed.","business_value":"Users can correct or update tasks in place, so the task list and report reflect current information.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form","when":"The user changes the title to a non-empty value and clicks save","then":"The backend stores the new not saved, the form shows a message that the title is required, and the stored title is unchanged"},{"given":"An existing task with a creation date of 1 March","when":"The user sets the due date to 28 February and clicks save","then":"The task is not saved, the form shows a message that the due date cannot be earlier than the creation date, and the stored due date is unchanged"},{"given":"An existing task is open in the edit form and the backend returns an error for the save request","when":"The user clicks save","then":"The stored task keeps its previous values, an error message is displayed, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A task that no longer exists is open in the edit form","when":"The user saves changes to it","then":"The backend responds with a task not found error, the form shows an error message, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A save request that sends a field value the backend does not accept","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with an invalid input error, stores no changes, and returns the error to the frontend"},{"given":"An update request that omits the title","when":"The backend receives the request","then":"The backend rejects the request with a missing mandatory field error and stores no changes"},{"given":"A save request that fails because of an internal server or database error","when":"The backend returns the error","then":"The backend stores no partial changes and the frontend shows an error message"},{"given":"A task with stored values exists","when":"The returns an error","when":"The user opens the task for editing","then":"An error message is shown, the form shows no prefilled values, and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"A task list row for an existing task and a save of that task has failed","when":"The task list is shown after the failed save","then":"The task list shows the previous values of the task, not the values the user
